description: Closed outward-exposure decision for every event kind admitted into a Principal Control Realm. ak.profile.principal_control_realm.v1 realm_event_kind_policy.allowed_event_kinds closes the write direction; this registry closes the read direction. A kind with an empty exposures[] is PCR-private and MUST NOT be reachable through any ak.open.* / ak.peer.* / cross-principal ak.self.* surface or public DID Document entry. A kind with exposures[] declares every path by which it legitimately leaves the Realm, each with its carrier form, exact schema location and gating authorization policy. Adding an outward path without registering it here is a release-gate failure, not an implementation detail.
registry_rules: The event_kind set MUST equal ak.profile.principal_control_realm.v1 realm_event_kind_policy.allowed_event_kinds exactly. A kind admitted for write with no exposure decision, and an exposure decision for a kind that cannot be written, both fail the gate.
exposures[] is a list, not a single value: one kind MAY leave the Realm through several independent paths, and each path carries its own authorization policy.
An empty exposures[] means PCR-private. The gate rejects a private kind whose literal kind string is reachable inside any outward carrier schema fragment registered here.

carrier declares what actually crosses the boundary: exact_event is the verbatim signed Event, derived_field is a projected value, receipt and authority commit are acceptance evidence over the Event, did_service_entry is a public DID Document service entry.
authorization_policy_id and anti_enumeration_policy_id MUST reference a policy registered below. public is an explicit policy value; a missing authorization_policy_id is never read as public.

Every exposure resolves exactly one reusable outward disclosure policy through outward_disclosure_policy_mapping, unless it carries an explicit outward_disclosure_policy_id override. The referenced policy is defined in outward-disclosure-policy-registry.json.

surface=operation requires an operation_id registered in operation-registry.json and a direction of request or response. surface=did_document carries no operation_id because a DID Document is published outside the operation registry.

Existing self signer-key historical results for a self-submitted Human PCR target expose only query_signing_key: original same-Station self-admission and exact target must bind the authenticated recipient fullAccount to the actual Human producer fullAccount and complete immutable historical authorization/proof. Controller Human Agent PCR genesis additionally binds original accepted provision, complete controllerAccount and original delegation in that same transaction. This does not expose PCR Events/history, grant scan/membership, alter floor, allow sibling/foreign admission, or reconstruct missing facts from current rows.

All carriers intersect the PCR profile pcr_governance_policy derived from verified accepted genesis provenance. Human PCR has no governance-change, handoff Snapshot/import, separated-governor proxy/publication or foreign-current-authority exposure; Human PCR genesis/Commit/current assertion MUST NOT be disclosed through the public authority-bundle operation; indistinguishable not_found applies. User-managed Agent PCR likewise forbids governance change, handoff and separated-governor proxy/publication/foreign current; existing generation-zero minimal authority disclosure remains governed by its own gates. The shared union is not per-subject permission. Unknown provenance fails closed; ordinary client projections do not establish provenance.

carrier_kinds.exact_event: The verbatim signed Event Envelope, byte-preserved by the carrier.
carrier_kinds.derived_field: A value projected from the Event or from the typed current result it writes; not the Event itself.
carrier_kinds.receipt: Signed acceptance evidence naming the Event.
carrier_kinds.did_service_entry: A service entry in a publicly resolvable DID Document.
carrier_kinds.realm_commit: The authority-signed RealmCommit that accepted the disclosed Event.

surface_kinds.operation: A registered service operation in operation-registry.json.
surface_kinds.did_document: A publicly resolvable DID Document, outside the operation registry.

authorization_policies.description: Current holder session bound to the exact target account authority pair. A recovery actor first completes the existing recovery transaction and becomes current holder; caller-declared intent is never authorization.
Caller and subject are both effective joined members of the request Collaboration Realm at evaluation time. That Realm MUST NOT be a Principal Control Realm.
A current authorization relationship between caller and subject: a shared Realm the caller is joined to, or a current call, session or Contact context.
Authenticated federation peer service with Source/Destination service DID and Content-Digest binding over the exact carrier bytes.
Authenticated Account Authority or Station service call carrying that operation's own authority evidence.
Deliberately unauthenticated. Only a value the subject itself chose to publish may use this policy.

The authenticated complete holder Account is the exact target of a durably verified pending_incoming Contact request. Only its request reference and optional message projection are disclosed; other states omit the message and no PCR Event access is granted.

Authenticated original producer hosting Station (or independently registered actual Service producer) forwards the exact signed native PCR Event only to its independently verified current governing authority. The current authority rechecks inception/placement, original producer, current device/root/action and native transaction. This is first admission only, never ordinary PCR replication, history scan, current disclosure, cached authorization or collaboration producer-fact issuance. Human PCR native writes use the owning Station boundary, never a foreign PCR governor; this does not restrict ordinary foreign-Human collaboration Event forwarding.

Only verified transferable Organization PCR provenance under the PCR profile pcr_governance_policy is eligible; Human and user-managed Agent reject without effects. Only the exact old/new governing Stations of the independently verified signed planned handoff may exchange the complete frozen private Snapshot. New authority remains unavailable until all original, current, private native-effect and retry/fence material is completely imported and verified. This grants no ordinary peer or member history visibility.

Only verified transferable Organization PCR provenance under the PCR profile pcr_governance_policy is eligible; Human and user-managed Agent reject without effects. Only the exact full holder Account hosting Station authenticated as Source may proxy to its independently verified current PCR authority. Private list/version/effects/policy values require the exact holder-session actor and active device rechecked at the PCR lock. Station-context admission commands have only the original opaque outcome. Exact request/nonce, current tenure, time window, source/head/cell high-water and current disclosure bind every response.

Only verified transferable Organization PCR provenance under the PCR profile pcr_governance_policy is eligible; Human and user-managed Agent reject without effects. Only the independently verified current authority of the exact holder inception PCR publishes the closed three private-effect cells to that holder hosting Station. Source/generation/window/head/cell high-water and equal-revision content bind the projection. No peer history, human disclosure, second business acceptance or arbitrary key is authorized.

Exact accepted C/S managed Account operation source: current authorized owning Service, exact subject and purpose, candidate binding, bounded private audit only; no generic PCR read or source preregistration.

anti_enumeration_policies.description: Unknown subject, wrong authority pair and unauthorized caller share one not_found outcome.
Per-subject failure uses a single value, so absent, withheld and unauthorized are indistinguishable.
Uniform failure shape plus a registered per-caller rate limit on the subject selector.
